summary: The day after graduation, the enormous Titan breaks Trost. Eren's first squad dies around him, and he is swallowed before he can reach the supply HQ.

segments.ja: 卒業の翌朝、訓練を終えた兵はトロスト区の壁に配置されます。配置の仕事は、砲の点検と、街を見下ろす番です。番の空気は、まだ式の夜の余熱を残しています。残っているエレンは、調査兵団の翼を明日の紙だと信じています。信じている横で、ミカサはマフラーを直し、アルミンは手順を頭の中で繰り返します。繰り返す朝は、平和な勤務に見えます。見える勤務が、今日の初陣になります。
segments.en: The morning after graduation, the soldiers who finished training are posted on the wall at Trost District. The work of the posting is checking cannon and watching the town from above. The air of the watch still holds the afterheat of the ceremony night. Eren, still in it, believes the Survey Corps wings are tomorrow's paper. Beside that belief, Mikasa straightens her scarf, and Armin repeats the procedure in his head. The morning they repeat looks like peaceful duty. The duty that looks peaceful becomes today's first battle.

segments.ja: 壁の外側から、熱い蒸気が上がります。上がる蒸気の中に、人よりはるかに高い体が現れます。現れる巨人は、五年前にシガンシナの門を砕いたのと同じ種類の大きさです。大きさに、砲の兵は照準を合わせようとします。合わせる前に、その手は壁の上の人間を払います。払われた衝撃で、エレンの装置は壊れ、アルミンは空に投げ出されます。投げ出された友を、エレンは落ちながら掴みます。
segments.en: Hot steam rises from outside the wall. Inside the rising steam, a body far taller than a person appears. The Titan that appears is the same kind of size that broke Shiganshina's gate five years ago. The cannon soldiers try to set their aim on that size. Before they set it, the hand sweeps the humans on top of the wall. The shock of the sweep breaks Eren's gear, and Armin is thrown into the air. Eren grabs the thrown friend while falling.

segments.en: Before Eren can bring a blade to the nape, the huge body vanishes into steam. The speed of vanishing is a withdrawal, not the end of an attack. After the withdrawal, a new hole stands in the wall. The hole that opened is Trost's outer gate. When the outer gate is broken, the town repeats Shiganshina's afternoon. Dot Pyxis watches the repeating scene from the wall. The commander who watches gives an order to move residents toward the inner gate. The order he gives is not yet a plan to plug the hole. It is not.

segments.ja: 新兵は、街の中隊に分けられます。分けられたエレンの班は、補給本部へ向かう役です。役の理由は、立体機動のガスが、壁の上の戦闘で減っている、です。減ったガスのまま街に残れば、ワイヤーは途中で止まります。止まる前に、本部の倉庫へ届く必要があります。必要がある道は、巨人の歩いている通りです。通りを、トーマスを含む同期が一緒に見ます。見る顔は、まだ訓練の模型を覚えています。覚えている模型と、今の街は違います。
segments.en: The recruits are divided into squads inside the town. Eren's divided squad has the role of heading to the supply headquarters. The reason for the role is that the ODM gas has decreased in the fight on the wall. If they stay in the town with the decreased gas, the cables stop halfway. Before they stop, they need to reach the depot at headquarters. The road they need is a street where Titans are walking. Classmates, including Thomas, look at the street together. The faces that look still remember the training dummies. The dummies they remember and the town now are different.

The speed he says it is faster than an instructor's call. Even with the fast call, the width of the street is narrower than the training woods. In the narrow sky, a cable hits a wall.

segments.en: Thomas is flying diagonally ahead of Eren. The path he is flying enters a Titan's hand. In the moment it enters, a classmate's name becomes a shout. Before it becomes that, the body disappears beyond the mouth. Eren does not chase the disappeared friend with a blade. The reason he does not chase is that he can no longer reach him. The fact of not reaching reduces the squad by one. Nobody writes the reduced number on a roster. On the battlefield where they do not write it, only Eren's eyes take on heat. The heat they take on is the three-year vow seeing blood for the first time.

segments.en: Eren drives the remaining blade into a Titan's fingers. The reason he drives it is not procedure. It is that he wants Thomas back. The anger of wanting him back misses the nape. The blade that missed shaves flesh, but it does not reach the fatal place. The Titan looks as if it does not feel the attack that does not reach. The indifference that can be seen burns Eren's fuel further. The way of flying that burns ignores the gas that remains. In the moment he ignores it, one cable cuts the sky. After it cuts, his altitude drops.

segments.en: When the Titan's mouth comes near Eren's torso, Armin comes in to help. Eren pushes the friend who comes in away from himself. The reason he pushes him away is to refuse both of them entering the same mouth. After the refusing push, Eren's body disappears into the mouth. Just before he disappears, he calls Armin's name. The voice that calls is not an order. It is close to run. Armin hears the words that are close as the words of his mother's day. The ear that hears still refuses the fact that he has lost his friend. Still refusing, he is left on a roof.

segments.en: Pyxis confirms the size of the hole with the cannon soldiers. The fact they confirm is that this gate will not be plugged before the day ends. The order to lift them is not cruelty. It is a calculation of numbers. The first battle of the recruits is included in the calculation. The commander is not watching the included deaths one by one. Without watching, he records the hole as a failure of the wall. The record is material for a later operation. The material is not yet a stone today.

segments.en: A first battle is not a day of winning skillfully. It is not. It is the first day a squad disappears against an opponent that is not a dummy. One of the names that disappear is Thomas. After Thomas, Eren himself enters a mouth. The report on the wall does not yet know that he entered. The report that does not know stops at the recruits are still struggling. The words that stop and the reality of the street are different. The next episode looks at the different reality from Mikasa's memory.

segments.en: Today's words. The first battle begins on the wall at Trost. A huge body appears together with steam, breaks the outer gate, and vanishes. Pyxis gives the order to lift people to the inner wall. Eren's squad heads for the supply headquarters. On the way, Thomas disappears. Eren loses one leg and one arm, pushes Armin clear, and then enters a mouth. Mikasa, on another street, does not know that yet. The lamp of headquarters is still far. The far failure continues into the next memory.

vocab.exampleEn: The morning after graduation, the soldiers who finished training are posted on the wall at Trost District.
